name: octocode-mcp
description: Code research MCP server for GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics
long_description: MCP server with code research tools across GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics. Agents orient, search, read exact evidence, and prove findings with typed continuations and sanitized output.

tools.name: ghSearch
tools.description: Search GitHub code or repositories, or browse a repository tree

tools.name: ghGetFileContent
tools.description: Fetch file content from GitHub repositories

tools.name: ghSearchHistory
tools.description: Search GitHub pull requests, issues, or commits

tools.name: ghGetHistoryItem
tools.description: Read one GitHub pull request, issue, commit, or ref comparison

tools.name: artifactSearch
tools.description: Find packages by capability or resolve dependency metadata and upstream source across eight ecosystems

tools.name: ghCloneRepo
tools.description: Clone a GitHub repository or subtree for local analysis

tools.name: localSearch
tools.description: Search local text with literal or regex matching

tools.name: astSearch
tools.description: Inspect local syntax, symbols, structural matches, files, trees, and graph topology

tools.name: astRewrite
tools.description: Preview or apply transactional structural rewrites with exact file-hash preconditions

tools.name: localFetch
tools.description: Read local file content with minification and exact slices

tools.name: lspSearch
tools.description: Run LSP semantic navigation over local files

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token for GitHub API (optional, increases rate limits)
